36. `mongodb.com/atlas-reconciliation-policy: "skip"` stops AKO from starting reconciliation for that resource until you remove the annotation. It is documented as a way to make manual changes without AKO undoing them. 37. The skip annotation pauses syncing with the spec; once it is removed the operator reconciles the resource and syncs it back with the spec. 38. `mongodb.com/atlas-resource-version-policy: "allow"` lets AKO use a resource whose version label does not match the version of the running AKO.

37. The Atlas Admin API rate-limits with a token bucket per endpoint set, scoped to GROUP (project), ORGANIZATION, USER or IP. A rejected request returns HTTP 429 with `errorCode: RATE_LIMITED_TOKEN_BUCKET` and a `detail` string that names the capacity and refill rate. — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/api/api-rate-limit/ 38. Atlas may return `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining` and `Retry-After` headers. It recommends honouring `Retry-After`, then exponential backoff with jitter.
